item.title: First iPhone Duo unboxing videos surface ahead of official reviews
item.description:
A series of iPhone Duo unboxing videos are now on YouTube, showing how the device ships in its open configuration, and how the display crease is practically invisible.


Unboxing the iPhone Duo - image credit: Kingmi Mobile

The first reviews of the iPhone Duo are expected shortly, although they may just prove tantalizing given how hard it is to buy one. But a series of three linked unboxing videos have surfaced, showing both the Star White and Night Sky color versions.

item.title: iPad Pro & Nintendo Switch 2 are perfect companions with a portable dock
item.description:
The Nintendo Switch 2 requires a compatible dock to work, and the official one is quite big, but Antank has a functioning dock that works great at a desk and on the go with your iPad Pro.


iPad Pro can be a display for the Nintendo Switch 2

When Apple introduced support for connecting devices like capture cards via USB-C in iPadOS 17, my first idea was to use the iPad Pro as a portable Nintendo Switch display. Due to restrictions with how the Nintendo Switch 2 works, third-party docks are harder to find, but I managed to get one from Antank.

This tiny dock can be purchased with a LAN port for $40 from Amazon or without a LAN port for $36 from Amazon, so it's quite a bit cheaper than even the standard dock sold by Nintendo. It supports 4K output and has two USB-A ports for accessory charging.

item.title: Sonos Play review: Sonos is back with the Goldilocks of portable speakers
item.description:
After a lengthy hardware hiatus, Sonos is back with its portable Play speaker. Between the impressive audio quality and AirPlay streaming, it's a solid choice for any Apple user.


Sonos Play review: Sonos is back with a new portable speaker

Without getting too into the weeds, the last couple of years have been unusually tough for Sonos. The speaker maker took a lot of well-deserved flak for rolling out an app update that wasn't ready.

This update revamped the UI, but it was also temporarily lacking essential features that many users depended on. Sonos quickly went into damage control mode.

item.title: Apple CEO John Ternus says design still means everything & includes whimsy
item.description:
"Design is how it works" rings true at Apple today, and John Ternus wants to assure everyone that respect for the user and building products that are beneficial is "job one."


John Ternus is still focused on design

John Ternus may be Apple's new CEO but he's not letting his new role interrupt his passion for industrial design. He emphasized that Apple had been working towards iPhone Duo for over 15 years in a previous interview.

A video version of that interview with Time was shared Tuesday with more conversation around the importance of design at Apple. Ternus starts by sharing his continued role of being involved with industrial design.
